column2: If a card that isn't a transforming double-faced card becomes a copy of a card with craft
column3: Outdated in part (conclusion B; ruling-conflicts-3, case 4): written 2023-11-10 (The Lost Caverns of Ixalan; the same text on all 24 cards with craft) under 712.14a of its day, 'If a player is instructed to put a card that isn’t a transforming double-faced card onto the battlefield transformed or converted, that card stays in its current zone.' (CR effective 2023-09-01, unchanged through the CR effective 2025-07-25). The Comprehensive Rules update effective 2025-09-19 (Marvel's Spider-Man) made 712.14a apply to any double-faced card ('If a spell or ability puts a double-faced card onto the battlefield “transformed” ...'; Wizards' ruling of 2025-09-19: 'if an effect attempts to put a modal double-faced card onto the battlefield transformed, it will enter transformed if its back face has a permanent type'), so a modal double-faced card that became a copy of a card with craft returns as its own back face unless that face is an instant or sorcery. Outdated only for modal double-faced cards: a card that isn't double-faced (Phyrexian Metamorph) still stays in exile, and the ruling stays cited for it (tests/keywords/k702_167_craft.rs, tests/rulings/r_s03_craft.rs). Logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md.
